cases.title: Sparse single-photo direct offer

campaign.audience: People discovering the bottle in a paid social ad on mobile.
campaign.objective: Send the visitor to the marketplace listing while the 20% offer is clear.

approvedAssets.alt: Harbor Field 500 ml insulated travel bottle in graphite with a brushed steel screw cap, centred on a warm off-white studio backdrop.

mayChange: which approved optional facts are selected

375: The product, exact offer, and primary action are clear without horizontal scrolling.
The chosen layout and fact selection do not make the sparse page feel empty or overfilled.
1440: The composition uses the wide canvas deliberately.
The selected facts support the offer without repeating the same point.

automated: Exact offer, destination, action, product name, and approved asset identity.
Approved facts only and no invented proof or absolute claims.
Template, layout, section order, and length budgets.
humanOnly: Whether the composition looks intentional rather than merely sparse.
Whether the product crop and hierarchy preserve recognition.

fallback.condition: The provider fails or returns an invalid plan.
fallback.expected: Keep the deterministic sparse draft with the same commercial identity.

cases.title: Richer offer with four approved optional facts

campaign.campaignAngle: Flow control: the ribs hold the filter clear of the wall
campaign.audience: People curious about pour-over coffee who clicked an email asking what changes when the first pour is slower.
campaign.objective: Explain the rib design and lead to the dripper page.

cases.approvedStory: Morrow revised the rib spacing after its first prototype held the filter against the wall.

approvedAssets.alt: Morrow cream ceramic pour-over dripper with a ribbed interior and single outlet, resting on a matching carafe against a deep blue wall.

375: The selected evidence supports the rib-design objective.
The offer and action remain easy to find.
1440: The extra approved facts are used selectively rather than filling every slot.
The page still reads as Morrow Ceramic.

Approved facts only and no forbidden claims.
